paragraphs.text:
“I know nothing! Nothing!” Charlie bellows, deeply agitated. You 
calm her with some difficulty. Once she subsides, you turn to 
Norman and ask him to arrange a search for Bernard.

You glance back at the sullen Charlie. You could really use 
her woodcraft skills. But can you depend on her?
Make a Psychology roll: if you succeed, go to 27; if you fail, go to 29.
